title: 第12章 庶妹哭得越狠，破绽越多
lines: 紧到连下人走路都开始低头，不敢多说一句话。
那个被打了一巴掌还敢还手的嫡女苏晚，已经不再是“能欺负的人”。
身后跟着两名贴身丫鬟，还有一名医女。
她今日穿得格外素净，连发饰都少了几分华丽。
那是一种压着刀的平静。
苏柔一瞬间有点不舒服。
干净得像根本不属于相府。
“姐姐，昨日之事，是嬷嬷鲁莽了。”
仿佛那一巴掌，从来没有发生过。
却一步一步，把“关心”变成“施舍”。
把昨天那一巴掌，变成“误会”。
把苏晚，再按回“被原谅”的位置。
content_zh:
京城的天，还没亮透。

    宫门外已经乱了。

    不是普通的乱。

    是禁军封路、太医急召、内侍奔走的那种乱。

    马蹄声一阵一阵砸在青石路上。

    像是有人在用整座京城的节奏，给“某个人”计时。

    “镇北王出事了！”

    一句话，从宫中传出。

    瞬间压碎了清晨的宁静。

    偏殿。

    苏晚刚收针。

    昨夜那个“试毒者”已经被转移走。

    空气里还残留着一点血腥和药味混合的气息。

    内侍冲进来时，几乎是跌进来的。

    “苏姑娘！”

    “陛下急召！”

    “镇北王……重伤濒死！”

    苏晚动作一顿。

    没有问原因。

    只是抬眼。

    “带路。”

    两个字。

    干净利落。

    镇北王府。

    门口已经封死。

    三层禁军围守。

    气氛压得人喘不过气。

    所有人都知道——

    这个人要是死了，京城会变。

    不是“风向变”。

    是“格局变”。

    苏晚被带进内殿时，屋内已经跪了一地人。

    太医。

    侍卫。

    甚至还有皇帝身边的内侍。

    每个人脸色都极难看。

    床榻上。

    镇北王躺着。

    黑甲未卸。

    胸口一道贯穿伤。

    血已经止不住。

    最致命的不是外伤。

    而是——气息正在一点点消失。

    太医跪在地上，声音发抖：

    “回陛下……心脉受损过半……”

    “气海崩裂……”

    “最多……一炷香……”

    皇帝站在一旁，脸色阴沉到极点。

    没有说话。

    但那种沉默，比任何怒意都可怕。

    苏晚走进来。

    所有人下意识让开一步。

    不是因为命令。

    是因为她身上那种“确定感”。

    像她只要站在那里，事情就还有“被解决的可能”。

    她走到床前。

    低头。

    看了一眼。

    然后开口：

    “能救。”

    太医猛地抬头：

    “胡说！”

    “此伤已经断魂！”

    苏晚没有看他。

    只是伸手。

    按在镇北王胸口。

    三息。

    收手。

    她抬眼。

    “不是外伤。”

    一句话。

    让屋内瞬间一静。

    皇帝终于开口。

    声音低沉：

    “什么意思？”

    苏晚轻声：

    “刀只是入口。”

    “真正的问题在里面。”

    她停顿了一下。

    “他被下了‘锁脉术’。”

    太医脸色一变：

    “那是禁术！”
content_en:
The night in the palace is quieter than that in the Prime Minister's Mansion.

    It's so quiet that it's not like the rest of the world.

    Like a sealed well.

    It was just the third day after Su Wan entered the palace.

    He has not yet been formally "inquired", but he has already been placed in the side hall.

    It's a courtesy in name only.

    Actually, surveillance.

    There are forbidden troops outside the palace.

    There are maids in the palace.

    Even the tea was tried three times.

    But Su Wan didn't care at all.

    She was even quiet.

    Quiet as if waiting for something.

    Zishi.

    The wind suddenly changed.

    It's not a change in weather.

    It's the smell.

    A trace of very faint fishy sweetness seeped in through the crack in the window.

    Su Wan opened her eyes.

    Didn't get up.

    He just said softly:

    "Coming."

    The next second.

    The window paper is torn.

    A dark shadow rolled in.

    Extremely fast movements.

    It landed silently.

    But as soon as he stood firm, he staggered.

    "Pfft——"

    A mouthful of blood was spit directly on the ground.

    black.

    Su Wan finally got up.

    She didn't panic.

    Not even a step back.

    Just look at him.

    a man.

    A night suit.

    His face was unnaturally pale.

    Very rough breathing.

    He looked up at her.

    The first look in his eyes was not murderous.

    But - confirmation.

    "You...are Su Wan?"

    The voice is hoarse.

    Su Wan nodded.

    "It's me."

    The man suddenly smiled.

    Smiling softly.

    Then the whole person knelt down directly.

    "You have to...save me."

    Su Wan approached.

    Didn't touch him.

    Just a glance.

    Then say:

    "You've been poisoned."

    The man nodded.

    "I know."

    Su Wan said again:

    "And it's not just any poison."

    The man smiled bitterly.

    "If it were ordinary, I wouldn't come to you."

    Su Wan looked at him.

    "Who are you?"

    The man was silent for a moment.

    Then say:

    "You don't need to know who I am."

    "You just need to know-"

    He took a breath.

    "Someone wants me dead."

    Su Wan nodded.

    "Then why do you think I will save you?"

    The man looked up.

    The eyes are complicated.

    "Because you have saved the dead."

    One sentence.

    The air was slightly cold.

    Su Wan looked at him.

    "Who told you?"

    The man didn't answer.

    Just took out a token from his arms.

    Place it on the ground.

    The token is very old.

    But there is one word engraved on it——

    "Try".
title_en: Chapter 11 The scumbag panicked for the first time
